extras.Quick Read Me:
Squirrel Kombat "Quick Read Me"

Quick Play
	Well actually, the quickest way to learn how to play is to select "Practice" for the play mode. There is a tutorial that should teach you everything you need to know. Below are some simple game use instructions.

Starting Screen Use
	The first button on the left is the play button, the middle button is the options screen button, and finally the button on the right is the quit button.

Options Screen Use
	Here you can set your sound, music, time, blood, difficulty, and key preferences.

Selection Screen Use
	You can the set the number of players with the buttons in the upper left. Choose a play mode with the buttons on the right. Choose a chararacter by using the directional keys for your player. Below is a list of the play modes and what they are:

1 on 1-If there is one player then it is you against the computer. If there are two players then it is you against another player.
Practice-Practice against a dummy that does not fight back. Either 1 or 2 player. If two players then there are two dummies. There is a great tutorial here.
Tournament-Go through and fight every player until you reach the top. Either 1 or 2 player. 
2 on 2-Two players against two computer controlled players.

	If in 1 on 1 or 2 on 2 the computer player is randomly chosen.

Scene Selector Use
	Use the arrows to select the scene you want. Then click on the preview of the scene to select it. Not all of the scenes are in the demo.

Playing
	For keys you can look in the options screen under "Keys". Don't forget about the Tutorial in Practice mode.

Points and High Scores
	You get points for doing damage to your opponent. The point values double if you hit them while they are hurt. The amount of points you get is directly related to how hard you hit your opponent. Even though you get points in all the modes, only points scored in the Tournament mode ( either one or two-player ) are valid for the high score list.


Troubleshooting
	First, make sure you have the DrawSprocket extension in the same folder as Squirrel Kombat or in your system folder. If for some reason you do not have this extension go to "http://www.monkeyfarm.com/games/download.html" and click DrawSprocket. If you have this extension installed and it still crashes, then try increasing the amount of memory you have allocated to it. To change the amount of memory you have allocated to Squirrel Kombat, first click Squirrel Kombat. Then choose "Get Info..." from the "File" menu or push Command-I. Then select "Memory" ( only required with newer versions of the Mac OS ). Then change the "Preferred..." and "Required..." amounts. If worst comes to worst, please e-mail us about it. Our e-mail address is "monkeyfarm@monkeyfarm.com".

What the demo lets you do:
	The demo lets you play 5 of the 11 characters. It also lets you play 2 of the 5 fight scenes. It will also let you go half way through the tournament. Have fun, but don't forget to get the full version.

What does the full version have?
The full version has the following:
	-11 Non-Secret characters
	-5 awesome and unique fight scenes
	-No more nagging
	-Access to secret cheats!

Plus all the great things that demo includes such as:
 -4 modes of play: one-on-one, practice, tournament, and two-on-two!
 -A point system to take competition to the next level!
 -4 normal moves, 4 combo moves, and 4 unique special moves!
 -Fantastic tutorial to teach you the basics, making the learning curve nonexistent.
 -Great AI opponents!
 -A great hint system!
 -Three levels of difficulty!
 -Real-time physics!
 -Real-time blood-letting! (optional)
 -It's got squirrels!
 -The best Mac fighting game!
 -2 -player team play!
 -125 different sprites! What's a sprite? Anything interactive on the screen. That could be body parts, fireballs, or power beams. Who knows?
 -Over 1000 different frames of animation!
 -Great graphics and sounds!
 -We promise, no bugs!
 -Way cool music and hilarious sound effects!

How To Register
	Currently we are using Kagi to process all of our payments. Kagi provides many ways to register and get the full version. The easiest method is to use the "Register" program included with "Squirrel Kombat".  If "Register" wasn't included, you can download it off our website.
Using "Register"
1. Open up "Register".
2. Fill in all the fields of information, your name, e-mail, payment method, and number of users.
3. Select "Squirrel Kombat" for the product you want to buy.
4. THIS IS IMPORTANT. Click the little word balloon before the words "Squirrel Kombat". Now fill in your registration code. The registration code appears in the lower-left corner of the first dialog( after it displays the company logo ), every time you start up the demo version of "Squirrel Kombat". Write this down before you register. This is very important to do otherwise you will not be able to get your unlock code as fast as you want it.
5. If you are going to send it through e-mail then choose "Save As" from the file menu. If postal click "Print".
Through E-Mail
1. Follow the steps in Using "Register".
2. Make a new e-mail message and send the output of the "Register" program to "sales@kagi.com". Do not send a screenshot or the actual "Register" program, just the saved file. You can either copy the output of the file (By pushing the "Copy..." button in the "Register" program ) and paste in the body of the e-mail, or you can attach the file you get by clicking "Save...". There is no need to compress the file.
Through Postal Mail
1. Follow the steps in Using "Register".
2.  Push the "Print..." button.
Send the printed file to the address below:

          Berkeley, California 94709-1405

1. Follow the steps in Using "Register".
2. Then fax the printout to:
			+1 510 652-6589
Over the Phone
	Note that this is not recommended. Call the below phone number and follow the instructions the automated phone system gives you.
			1 (510) 658-5244.
How Long Will It Take?
	There are 2 delays. One for the information to get to Kagi and the second for Kagi to send the information to me.  You should get a confirmation message from them on the day that they recieve it, (3-4 days). Then it is up to us to send you the correct unlock code, which at maximum could take 5 days from recieving the information. This estimate is through e-mail, if you use postal mail instead it will take longer. This delay may take longer if you forget to fill in the "comment" with your "registration code" because we will have to e-mail you and find out what your registration code is.
Questions or Problems
	Please send all questions and problems to monkeyfarm@monkeyfarm.com.

What does it cost?
	Fifteen dollars. Yes, that's $15.00. We can charge less than a commercial software company because we have reduced costs. But we can not continue to make great Macintosh games without you. Remember that this is only a demo version, the full game is much better. If you want to support Monkey Farm Software, shareware, and the Mac, then please register.
